text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Verxina, I noticed a crowd gathering in 
front of the stage.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there was a signboard 
put up. It looked like there's going to be 
an idol concert.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Verxina-san! That's right, the stage 
for the talented local idol I've been 
following is about to start right now...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tarumae-san. You never miss a single 
detail, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Watching is a great way to learn, after 
all. I've got to take in all the good 
points!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What admirable dedication. Trainer, shall 
we watch along as well?

text_block_list.name: Local Idol
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo, everyone~! Let's get hyped 
today~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Local Idol
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, first song! Here comes 
'Hometown DAYS'---!"

text_block_list.name: Local Idol
text_block_list.text:
"I can hear it, the voice of my hometown, 
Ah, heave-ho, heave-ho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a powerful singing voice. Full of 
energy, you could really feel her spirit 
to cheer on her hometown.
choice_data_list:
That's a singing voice you can feel right 
in your gut.

That's a singing voice you can feel right 
in your gut, huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It seems you've trained your throat for 
the lower register to create a voice with 
a solid core—I see."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Verxina watched the 
concert with rapt attention...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That was so amazing~~! Especially the 
singing! The sheer power of her voice 
totally blew me away...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san. There's something I noticed 
during the live performance as well, if 
you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, tell me, tell me! I wanna hear your 
perspective, Verxina-san!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Her vocal fundamentals were rock solid. 
She must have undergone quite an extensive 
amount of vocal training."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Particularly her lower register, which is 
usually hard to project, was powerful. I 
didn't hear the slightest wobble.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, totally, I get it! I wonder how they 
manage to make that voice.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Relaxing your body is the standard 
practice for low notes. Just like taking a 
yawn—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! That kind of singing voice! 
Verxina-san, would you teach me again 
sometime?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. There's no need to hold 
back.
choice_data_list:
Huh, so you two are doing vocal lessons 
together.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Thanks to Verxina-san, I've 
been able to sing more and more difficult 
songs!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I wonder if the experience of 
teaching my little sisters since I was 
young is paying off.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, with gratitude to your little 
sisters too! Here we go—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Aaah... mmph! Haaaah♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Tarumae-san. If you 
pay closer attention to the lingering 
finish, it'll become even better.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The way she sang as a locodol was full of 
longing, as if she were pouring her heart 
out to her distant hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah~♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That really resonated with me. Now, let's 
sing today's song together—one, two, go!

text_block_list.name: Verxina & Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I can hear it, the voice of my hometown, 
Ah, heave-ho, heave-ho!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yep, perfect!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh, I think I've got the hang of it! 
Thank you, Verxina-san!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm looking forward to your next 
concert.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I want you to see the results too♪ 
Oh, I know! I'll invite you to my next 
live concert!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course, two tickets, including one for 
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll keep my schedule clear. Isn't 
that right, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best to properly hype everyone 
up!
Even my share...? Are you sure?
Even my share... are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll keep my schedule clear. Isn't 
that right, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best to properly hype everyone 
up!
Even my share...? Are you sure?
Even my share... are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't we borrow footage 
of Tarumae-san's past performances and 
study them together?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I think you'll have even more fun if you 
get a feel for the atmosphere and the 
chants.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If there's anything you don't understand, 
I'll be sure to teach you properly. After 
all, that's my specialty!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Let's cheer on Tarumae-san 
together.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you are quite busy. Only if your 
schedule allows, of course..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Please, at least let me hope.
